content: Obesity is a risk factor for the development of several cancers, including breast, colon, and gynecologic carcinomas.1,2 Recent studies have clarified that obesity not only correlates with carcinogenesis but also affects the prognosis of patients with various cancers. For example, obesity has been associated with poor prognosis in breast3,4 and colon cancers,5,6 whereas favorable outcomes have been reported in obese patients with gastric7 or renal8 cancers.
